Union Berlin 's Christopher Trimmel was a constant threat from the corner flag, forcing the Mainz 05 defense to remain alert. The deadlock was finally broken in the 38th minute following a significant lapse in concentration. A poor execution by goalkeeper Robin Zentner allowed Union Berlin to seize possession. Aljoscha Kemlein provided the cross, and Andrej Ilic rose highest to power a header home, giving the visitors a narrow lead going into the interval. Mainz Strike Back and VAR Drama Mainz 05 returned for the second half with renewed vigor and found an equalizer almost immediately. In the 48th minute, Paul Nebel turned provider for Sheraldo Becker , who clinicaly finished with his left foot to restore parity. The momentum swung heavily in favor of the hosts, and they thought they had taken the lead in the 59th minute through Phillip Tietz . However, after a tense VAR review, the goal was overturned due to an offside position. This moment proved to be a psychological turning point as both managers turned to their benches to influence the final stages. Late Surge Secures the Points As the clock ticked toward full-time, Union Berlin 's tactical substitutions paid dividends. In the 88th minute, Oliver Burke —who had recently replaced Andrej Ilic —found himself in the right place to convert a left-footed strike following a key pass from Derrick Koehn . With Mainz 05 pushing forward in desperate search of another equalizer, they were caught on the counter in stoppage time. In the 91st minute, Tim Skarke burst forward and teed up Josip Juranovic , who made no mistake from close range. The final whistle confirmed a 3-1 victory for Union Berlin , rewarding their clinical finishing in a hard-fought contest.

Ilic Takes Center Stage Union Berlin wasted no time establishing their dominance in the opening stages. In the 10th minute, Andras Schafer turned provider, delivering a ball that allowed Andrej Ilic to tap home for an early lead. The hosts continued to press, and their persistence was rewarded again just before the interval. In the 42nd minute, Oliver Burke linked up with Andrej Ilic , who unleashed a powerful right-footed strike from outside the penalty area to double the advantage and leave the Augsburg defense reeling. In the 54th minute, Livan Burcu found Andras Schafer in space, and the midfielder mirrored Ilic’s earlier feat by beating the keeper with a precise shot from distance. Despite the pressure, Union Berlin remained composed, even as Han-Noah Massengo and Aljoscha Kemlein picked up yellow cards in a physical battle for midfield control. Late Drama and Final Whistle FC Augsburg finally found a breakthrough in the 89th minute when Woo-Yeong Jeong clinicaly finished with his left foot to give the traveling fans a moment of hope. The drama continued into stoppage time as Union Berlin 's Dmytro Bogdanov missed a clear header that could have further extended the scoreline.
